name: math30_mathglm_anneal
description: Mid-training anneal mixture for the tail of a `math30_mathglm` run, passed as --anneal-weights. It keeps the `math30_anneal` shape -- half the tokens mathematics, the raw-FineWeb anchor dropped, the shift toward showing the steps -- and splits the arithmetic budget the same way the bulk profile does: `mathglm` at 10% for chained multi-operation evaluation, `math_drills` at 7% for the column-level algorithm MathGLM never spells out. `openmath_instruct` is held at 16%, unchanged from `math30_anneal`, because the habit the anneal should leave behind is reading a word problem and working it, not arithmetic in isolation; the extra weight comes out of `finemath_4plus`, `open_web_math` and `deepmind_math`. Source iterators are shared with the bulk stage, so nothing here is a second pass over text the model has already seen; pair it with --on-exhausted redistribute.
